description: Execute an Office.js code snippet directly against the active workbook. Returns any error plus the list of Office.js APIs the code used that are not yet implemented. Edits synced before a script error remain applied.

code.description: Office.js JavaScript to run against the active workbook. `context` (RequestContext) and `Excel` are in scope; call `await context.sync()` to flush writes.

name: executeOfficeJs
